title: Young Man in Winter Overcoat and Fedora in Snow, 1930s Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length winter snapshot of a smartly dressed young man posing in the snow in front of a residential house with a Craftsman-style porch. He is wearing a dark, heavy wool overcoat with the collar turned up, leather gloves, rolled or cuffed trousers, dark dress shoes, and a stylishly tilted fedora hat. Bright, low winter sunlight casts prominent shadows across the snowy yard and wooden porch steps.
